description: Most West Bank Palestinians are barred from travelling abroad through Ben Gurion. Holders of a Palestinian passport and green ID may cross from Jordan only via the King Hussein Bridge - not at other crossings, not through the airport.
energy_note: The airport is forty minutes away and it is not for you.

aspect: So every flight starts with an international border
description: Queen Alia in Amman becomes the home airport. Reaching it means the Jericho side, the Israeli side at Allenby, the Jordanian side at King Hussein, then a drive to Amman - before check-in.
money_note: Crossing fees, transit, taxis, per trip, each way.
energy_note: Three borders before the departures board.

aspect: The hotel you must buy because of opening hours
description: For about two decades Allenby ran 08:00-23:30 on weekdays and 08:00-15:30 at weekends. An early flight from Amman therefore required crossing the day before and paying for a night, or sleeping in the terminal.
money_note: A night in Amman, per trip, forced by the timetable.
energy_note: A hotel bill created by a gate's closing time.

aspect: It took over a decade of US pressure to extend the hours
description: American administrations pushed for more than ten years. Israel moved Allenby to near-full-time operation in 2023, after an earlier 24/7 pilot lasting one week was reversed.
energy_note: Ten years of diplomacy to open a gate at night.

aspect: A cheap flight is not cheap
description: The headline fare is the smallest component. Crossing fees, two taxis, a hotel, a day of leave each way and the risk of the whole thing being cancelled at the bridge are the actual price.
money_note: Per journey, on top of the ticket.
energy_note: The ticket is the cheap part.

aspect: Which prices you out of the things that need travel
description: A conference, a job interview, a scholarship weekend, a funeral. Each costs two days and several hundred dollars more for you than for the other person invited, so you decline more of them, and the pattern of declining becomes your career.
energy_note: Saying no to things because of a bridge.

description: An earlier 24/7 arrangement at Allenby, requested by the Biden administration, ran as a pilot for one week and was then reversed. Israel moved to near-full-time operation only in 2023, after more than a decade of US pressure.
energy_note: A week of normal opening hours, then back.
